def logLoop (square : I80) (ul uh : ℤ) : ℕ → LogState
  | 0 => ⟨⟨ul,uh⟩,I80.raw 0⟩
  | n+1 => logStep square n (logLoop square ul uh n)

def buildFrom (g : ℕ) : ℕ → Array Node → Array Node
  | 0, nodes => nodes
  | remaining + 1, nodes => buildFrom g remaining (appendNode g nodes)
